dialect.detail: JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) running on Linux, compiled with GnuCOBOL. Program ORCS02 handles inpatient co-payment calculation (負担金額算定サブ).
evidence: COPY count 33, CALL count 87 consistent with GnuCOBOL/ORCA style

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/レセプト) system — inpatient patient co-payment amount calculation subprogram for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCS02 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that calculates patient co-payment amounts for inpatient (入院) claims. It handles multiple public assistance (公費) insurance combinations, regional subsidy rules, consumption tax, and various rounding/ceiling logic for different Japanese prefectures and insurance types.

notable_features: Large working-storage with complex insurance co-payment tables (HOKEN-FUTAN-AREA, HOKEN-ZAN-AREA, HOKEN-KAISU-TABLE)
OCCURS clauses for daily/monthly accumulation arrays (up to 31 days)
87 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage — uses PIC 9 binary arithmetic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Revision history spanning 2002–2005 with 39+ named revisions
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing Japanese comments to appear as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 508117 bytes (10064 lines); full program body not visible but structure is clear. This is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system for Linux.
